content.text:
Market Research Report: Top 10 Most Popular Cafes in Singapore (by Google Reviews & Ratings)

To conduct this market analysis, the top 10 most popular cafes in Singapore by Google reviews and ratings were identified across all five national regions (North, South, East, West, and Central). For each cafe, the live official website and menu page has been opened and left active in its own dedicated browser tab.

---

### Regional Coverage & Summary Table

1. **Citrus By The Pool** | **North (Woodlands)** | 4.9★ (26,902 reviews) | Tab ID: 787784524 | ~1 hr 6 min from Tampines MRT
2. **My Awesome Cafe** | **Central (Telok Ayer)** | 4.7★ (7,953 reviews) | Tab ID: 787784525 | ~41 min from Tampines MRT
3. **PS.Cafe at Harding Road** | **Central (Dempsey Hill)** | 4.4★ (6,508 reviews) | Tab ID: 787784526 | ~1 hr from Tampines MRT
4. **Tiong Bahru Bakery** | **Central (Tiong Bahru)** | 4.3★ (3,378 reviews) | Tab ID: 787784527 | ~47 min from Tampines MRT
5. **Wildseed Café at The Alkaff Mansion** | **South (Telok Blangah)** | 4.5★ (3,185 reviews) | Tab ID: 787784528 | ~1 hr 11 min from Tampines MRT
6. **Common Man Coffee Roasters** | **Central (River Valley)** | 4.4★ (3,077 reviews) | Tab ID: 787784529 | ~46 min from Tampines MRT
7. **Chye Seng Huat Hardware** | **Central (Lavender / Jalan Besar)** | 4.3★ (2,911 reviews) | Tab ID: 787784530 | ~33 min from Tampines MRT
8. **Burnt Cones Gelato** | **West (Sunset Way / Clementi)** | 4.7★ (2,802 reviews) | Tab ID: 787784531 | ~1 hr 17 min from Tampines MRT
9. **The Coastal Settlement** | **East (Changi)** | 4.2★ (2,608 reviews) | Tab ID: 787784533 | ~45 min from Tampines MRT
10. **Canopy HortPark** | **South (Alexandra / Southern Ridges)** | 4.1★ (2,056 reviews) | Tab ID: 787784532 | ~1 hr 16 min from Tampines MRT

*(Note: Privé @ Keppel Bay, which previously had 2,640 reviews, was verified on Google Maps and found to be permanently closed with an expired domain; it was substituted with Canopy HortPark, a premier live dining destination in the South region).*

---

### Detailed Cafe Breakdown

#### 1. Citrus By The Pool (North Region)
- **Open Tab**: Tab ID `787784524`
  - **Tab Title**: *Citrus By The Pool - Order online for delivery & pickup!*
  - **Tab URL**: `https://ordercitrusbythepool.oddle.me/en_SG` (Official website: `https://www.citrusbythepool.com/`)
- **Location**: 3 Woodlands Street 13, Woodlands Swimming Complex, Singapore 738600
- **Google Reputation**: 4.9★ rating based on 26,902 reviews (highest review volume of any cafe in Singapore)
- **Menu Offerings**:
  - Halal-certified Western-fusion and authentic Thai dishes.
  - *Appetisers & Salads*: House Salad with Cajun Chicken Thigh ($9.50), Caesar Salad ($6.90), Homemade Mushroom Soup ($6.90), Thai Mango Salad ($6.90), Glass Noodle Seafood Salad ($6.90).
  - *Platters & Sides*: Snack Attack Platter ($18.90), Golden Bites Platter ($14.50), Truffle Fries ($8.90), Cheese Fries ($6.90).
  - *Mains, Pastas & Burgers*: Tom Yum Seafood Pasta, Grilled Cajun Chicken, Ribeye Steaks, Fish & Chips, Beef Burgers, Thai curries, and fried rice noodles.
  - *Beverages & Desserts*: Signature thick milkshakes, Belgian waffles, lava cakes, and artisanal hot/iced coffee ($3.50–$6.50).
- **Pricing**:
  - Budget to Mid-range (~S$10 to S$25 per person).
  - Weekday Lunch Deals start from S$9.90 (Mon–Thu, 11am–4pm).
- **Unique Selling Points (USPs)**:
  - Rare late-night operating hours from 11:00 AM to 5:00 AM daily (last order at 4:00 AM), making it a major supper sanctuary in the North.
  - Halal-certified casual dining situated right at Woodlands Swimming Complex.
  - High-engagement promotions: "Milkshake Madness" (1-for-1 Milkshakes every Monday) and 20% off all desserts every night after 11:00 PM.
- **Travel Time from Tampines MRT**:
  - **~1 hour 6 minutes**: Direct ride on Bus 168 from Tampines Ave 4 (Blk 503) directly towards Woodlands Interchange / Swimming Complex, or via Downtown Line to North-South Line (Woodlands MRT) + short bus ride.

---

#### 2. My Awesome Cafe (Central Region)
- **Open Tab**: Tab ID `787784525`
  - **Tab Title**: *MyAwesomeCafe www.myawesomecafe.com*
  - **Tab URL**: `https://www.myawesomecafe.com/`
- **Location**: 202 Telok Ayer Street, Singapore 068639
- **Google Reputation**: 4.7★ rating based on 7,953 reviews
- **Menu Offerings**:
  - Wholesome European cafe food and sharing platters.
  - *Signatures*: "My Awesome Salad" (generous heap of mesclun greens, smoked salmon, avocado, duck rillettes, chicken breast, and tomatoes), Awesome Sandwiches on artisanal French breads, and Foie Gras Burgers.
  - *Platters & Evening*: Artisanal cheese and charcuterie boards, antipasti platters, duck confit, craft beers, boutique French wines, and classic espresso beverages ($5–$7).
- **Pricing**:
  - Mid-range (~S$18 to S$38 per person).
  - Salads and sandwiches range between S$15 and S$26; charcuterie sharing platters range from S$30 to S$45.
- **Unique Selling Points (USPs)**:
  - Housed on the ground floor of the historic Chung Hwa Free Clinic (established 1952), preserving original retro TCM shophouse tiles, signage, and architecture.
  - Eccentric interior filled with thrifted retro furniture, upcycled industrial lighting, and vintage dinnerware.
  - Heartfelt, community-driven hospitality led by founder Franck Hardy ("resident Mr. Awesome").
- **Travel Time from Tampines MRT**:
  - **~41 minutes**: Direct MRT ride on the Downtown Line from Tampines MRT Station (DT32) straight to Telok Ayer MRT Station (DT18), followed by a 2-minute sheltered walk.

---

#### 3. PS.Cafe at Harding Road (Central Region)
- **Open Tab**: Tab ID `787784526`
  - **Tab Title**: *PS.Cafe Harding Road — PS.Cafe*
  - **Tab URL**: `https://www.pscafe.com/pscafe-at-harding-road/`
- **Location**: 28B Harding Road, Dempsey Hill, Singapore 249549
- **Google Reputation**: 4.4★ rating based on 6,508 reviews
- **Menu Offerings**:
  - Australian-inspired luxury cafe fare, brunch classics, and gourmet comfort food.
  - *Signatures*: The iconic Truffle Shoestring Fries tossed with grated parmesan and truffle oil ($19–$21), PS. Burger ($33), Tiger Beer Battered Fish & Chips ($34), Blue Moon Crab Tart ($35), and Spaghettini Bolognese.
  - *Brunch & Bakery*: Eggs Benedict, Croque Madame, and towering signature bakery desserts such as Double Chocolate Blackout Cake ($18) and Sticky Date Pudding drenched in toffee sauce ($16).
- **Pricing**:
  - Upscale / Premium (~S$40 to S$70 per person).
- **Unique Selling Points (USPs)**:
  - Dempsey Hill's pioneer flagship cafe venue (founded in 1999 as a cozy cafe in Projectshop).
  - Breathtaking glasshouse architecture with soaring floor-to-ceiling glass windows offering panoramic views of surrounding lush jungle foliage.
  - Benchmark setter in Singapore for upscale cafe ambiance, date nights, and celebration dining.
- **Travel Time from Tampines MRT**:
  - **~1 hour**: Downtown Line from Tampines MRT to Botanic Gardens / Stevens MRT Station, then transfer to Bus 7, 77, 106, or 174 to Dempsey Road, followed by a short walk through Dempsey Hill.

---

#### 4. Tiong Bahru Bakery (Central Region)
- **Open Tab**: Tab ID `787784527`
  - **Tab Title**: *Tiong Bahru Bakery*
  - **Tab URL**: `https://tiongbahrubakery.com/`
- **Location**: 56 Eng Hoon Street, #01-70, Singapore 160056 (Original flagship outlet)
- **Google Reputation**: 4.3★ rating based on 3,378 reviews
- **Menu Offerings**:
  - Traditional French viennoiseries, artisan sourdough, gourmet sandwiches, and specialty coffee.
  - *Pastries*: Celebrated French Butter Croissants ($4.50–$4.80), caramelized Kouign Amann ($6.00–$7.50), Almond Croissants, Pain au Chocolat, Apple Turnovers, and seasonal tarts.
  - *Savoury*: Quiche Lorraine ($10–$12), Croque Monsieur, Baguette Sandwiches (Brie & Roasted Mushrooms, Smoked Salmon, Roast Beef at $11–$14).
  - *Beverages*: Signature Magic (double ristretto with flat milk), Cold Brews, Matcha Lattes, and Hot Chocolate.
- **Pricing**:
  - Budget to Mid-range (~S$10 to S$22 per person).
- **Unique Selling Points (USPs)**:
  - Founded in 2012 in collaboration with famed French master baker Gontran Cherrier; widely credited with sparking Singapore’s modern artisan bakery movement.
  - Pastries are baked fresh in small batches throughout the day using premium French flour and French Normandy butter.
  - Nestled within the iconic Art Deco conservation shophouses of Tiong Bahru estate.
- **Travel Time from Tampines MRT**:
  - **~47 minutes**: East-West Line from Tampines MRT to Outram Park MRT or Tiong Bahru MRT, or Downtown Line to Chinatown Station followed by bus 851/63 into Eng Hoon Street.

---

#### 5. Wildseed Café at The Alkaff Mansion (South Region)
- **Open Tab**: Tab ID `787784528`
  - **Tab Title**: *The Alkaff Mansion – Wildseed Café*
  - **Tab URL**: `https://www.wildseedcafe.sg/the-alkaff-mansion/`
- **Location**: 10 Telok Blangah Green, Singapore 109178
- **Google Reputation**: 4.5★ rating based on 3,185 reviews
- **Menu Offerings**:
  - Modern cafe fare infused with Spanish twists, high tea, and floral patisseries.
  - *Brunch & Mains*: Big Pan Breakfast ($28 - smoked chicken bockwurst, seared avocado, eggs, roma tomatoes, tater tots, sourdough), Benny Croissant Toast, Truffle Brie Pizza, Wagyu Beef Burger, Soft Shell Crab Burger, Truffle Carbonara.
  - *High Tea & Sweets*: Circuit de Jardin High Tea set, floral-infused chiffon cakes, tarts, and botanical lattes.
- **Pricing**:
  - Mid-to-High range (~S$25 to S$45 per person).
- **Unique Selling Points (USPs)**:
  - Situated on the ground level of the stately 1918 colonial Alkaff Mansion atop Telok Blangah Hill.
  - Picturesque European glass conservatory and outdoor garden patio surrounded by nature.
  - Exceptionally popular pet-friendly dining retreat with wide outdoor lawns for pet owners.
- **Travel Time from Tampines MRT**:
  - **~1 hour 11 minutes**: Downtown Line from Tampines MRT to Chinatown / Telok Ayer MRT, transfer to Bus 131 to Telok Blangah Green, followed by a walk up the Telok Blangah hill path.

---

#### 6. Common Man Coffee Roasters (Central Region)
- **Open Tab**: Tab ID `787784529`
  - **Tab Title**: *Common Man Coffee Roasters Menu - Brunch Cafe, Wine Bar & Dine In*
  - **Tab URL**: `https://commonmancoffeeroasters.com/pages/our-menus`
- **Location**: 22 Martin Road, #01-00, Singapore 239058
- **Google Reputation**: 4.4★ rating based on 3,077 reviews
- **Menu Offerings**:
  - Third-wave specialty coffees and elevated Australian-style brunch (transitioning to a natural wine bar at night).
  - *Day Menu*: Common Man Full Breakfast ($32–$36 with organic eggs, bacon, pork sausage, herbed tomato, hash brown, portobello mushrooms, sourdough), Turkish Common Man Breakfast (phyllo-wrapped soft egg, crispy feta, olives, hummus, pita), Croissant Croque Monsieur, Organic Eggs Benedict, and Umami Mushroom Toast.
  - *Coffee*: In-house roasted single origins, Kalita Wave pour-overs, Nitro Honey Brews, and signature espresso blends ($5.50–$9.00).
- **Pricing**:
  - Mid-to-High range (~S$28 to S$50 per person).
- **Unique Selling Points (USPs)**:
  - Established in 2013 in partnership with Melbourne’s Five Senses Coffee, CMCR spearheaded Asia's specialty coffee wave.
  - Houses the renowned CMCR Barista Academy and wholesale roastery.
  - Consistently lauded by international travel publications for serving the benchmark brunch in Southeast Asia.
- **Travel Time from Tampines MRT**:
  - **~46 minutes**: Direct Downtown Line from Tampines MRT to Fort Canning MRT Station (DT20), followed by an 8-minute scenic walk along the Singapore River / Robertson Quay into Martin Road.

---

#### 7. Chye Seng Huat Hardware (Central Region)
- **Open Tab**: Tab ID `787784530`
  - **Tab Title**: *Chye Seng Huat Hardware | Coffee, Cakes & Cold Brews Delivery*
  - **Tab URL**: `https://cshhcoffee.com/`
- **Location**: 150 Tyrwhitt Road, Singapore 207563
- **Google Reputation**: 4.3★ rating based on 2,911 reviews
- **Menu Offerings**:
  - Innovative specialty coffee beverages, craft brews, brunch mains, and baked treats.
  - *Signatures*: Bottled Nitro Black Matter cold brew, espresso flights (single origin vs blend), and White/Black coffees.
  - *Food*: CSHH Breakfast ($29.43), Triple Cheese Grilled Sandwich ($22.89), Chicken Toast ($22.89), CSHH Wagyu Burger, Truffle Fries, and freshly baked pastries ($6–$8).
  - *The Courtyard*: Transforms into an evening beer garden after 5:00 PM featuring craft beers on tap and bar bites.
- **Pricing**:
  - Mid-range (~S$18 to S$35 per person).
- **Unique Selling Points (USPs)**:
  - Flagship concept space by PPP Coffee (formerly Papa Palheta) retaining the vintage exterior and metal roller doors of a 1950s hardware store.
  - Standout 360-degree circular island coffee bar in the centre of the main hall, creating an interactive, transparent stage between baristas and guests.
  - Includes an on-site coffee roastery, coffee tasting "Annex", and alfresco courtyard.
- **Travel Time from Tampines MRT**:
  - **~33 minutes** (Fastest travel time among all central cafes): Direct Downtown Line train from Tampines MRT to Jalan Besar MRT Station (DT22) or Bendemeer MRT Station (DT23), followed by an easy 5-to-7-minute walk.

---

#### 8. Burnt Cones Gelato (West Region)
- **Open Tab**: Tab ID `787784531`
  - **Tab Title**: *Burnt Cones — Gelato made by hand. Pints to your door.*
  - **Tab URL**: `https://www.burntcones.com/`
- **Location**: 105 Clementi Street 12, #01-02, Sunset Way, Singapore 120105
- **Google Reputation**: 4.7★ rating based on 2,802 reviews
- **Menu Offerings**:
  - Small-batch artisan gelato, custom waffle cones, buttermilk waffles, and self-roasted specialty coffee.
  - *Gelato Flavours*:
    - Supremo: Pure Sicilian Pistacchio ($25/pint, ~$6–$7/scoop).
    - Signatures: 85% Dark Chocolate (single-origin Valrhona), Maple Pecan (toasted pecans, maple syrup, brown butter), White Chocolate Blondie, Peppermint.
    - Premium / Local: Ube (purple yam), Black Sesame, SōngHè Rice Gelato, Chrysanthemum Goji.
    - Sorbets (Dairy-free): Strawberry Sorbet, Mango Passion, Coconut Lychee.
  - *Specialty Coffee*: Espresso, Flat White, Long Black ($4.00–$6.50).
- **Pricing**:
  - Budget-friendly dessert dining (~S$6 to S$15 per person for scoops, cones, waffles, and coffee; pints S$18–$25).
- **Unique Selling Points (USPs)**:
  - Famous for its proprietary handmade waffle cones tailored across multiple distinct burn/caramelisation profiles to complement rich gelato.
  - Open late until midnight (12:00 AM daily), serving as a staple late-night dessert haven in the West.
  - Located in Sunset Way’s leafy, laid-back neighborhood food enclave.
- **Travel Time from Tampines MRT**:
  - **~1 hour 17 minutes**: Downtown Line from Tampines MRT to Beauty World MRT Station (or East-West Line to Clementi MRT), followed by Bus 154 or 184 to Clementi Street 12 / Sunset Way.

---

#### 9. The Coastal Settlement (East Region)
- **Open Tab**: Tab ID `787784533`
  - **Tab Title**: *Menus | TCS*
  - **Tab URL**: `https://www.thecoastalsettlement.com/menus` (Official website: `https://www.thecoastalsettlement.com/`)
- **Location**: 200 Netheravon Road, Changi, Singapore 508529
- **Google Reputation**: 4.2★ rating based on 2,608 reviews
- **Menu Offerings**:
  - Nostalgic East-meets-West comfort cuisine and hearty sharing plates.
  - *Signatures*: Wagyu Beef & Mushroom Thin-Crust Pizza ($28–$34), TCS Nasi Lemak (coconut rice with spiced fried chicken and sambal), Portobello Mushroom Fries with truffle mayonnaise, Har Cheong Gai (crispy prawn paste chicken wings), Kurobuta Pork Ribs, and Swiss Rosti with smoked salmon.
  - *Brunch & Desserts*: Weekend brunch egg skillets, buttermilk waffles with gelato, retro ice kachang, and craft draft beers.
- **Pricing**:
  - Mid-to-High range (~S$30 to S$55 per person).
- **Unique Selling Points (USPs)**:
  - Tucked away inside a historic colonial bungalow enclave on the tranquil coastal edge of Changi.
  - Decorated as a nostalgic living museum filled with antique vehicles, retro Vespa scooters, vintage bicycles, rotary phones, and heritage curios.
  - Expansive alfresco patio surrounded by canopy trees, ideal for family outings, cyclists, and weekend nature respites.
- **Travel Time from Tampines MRT**:
  - **~45 minutes**: Direct connection via Bus 29 from Tampines Bus Interchange directly to Netheravon Road (Bef Changi Golf Club / The Coastal Settlement).

---

#### 10. Canopy HortPark (South Region)
- **Open Tab**: Tab ID `787784532`
  - **Tab Title**: *Canopy HortPark | Garden Dining and Events on the Southern Ridges*
  - **Tab URL**: `https://www.canopygardendining.com/outlets/hortpark`
- **Location**: 33 Hyderabad Road, #01-01 HortPark, Singapore 119578
- **Google Reputation**: 4.1★ rating based on 2,056 reviews
- **Menu Offerings**:
  - Wholesome all-day Western dining in a garden setting.
  - *Set Lunch Deal*: $20.90++ Set Lunch (choice of Soup of the Day or House Salad + Main such as Fish & Chips, Grilled Chicken Thigh, Prawn Aglio Olio, or Vegetarian Pasta + soft drink/tea/coffee).
  - *Weekend Brunch ($9–$15)*: Egg Truffle Focaccia ($9), Smoked Salmon Focaccia ($12), Sautéed Mushroom Pita ($12), Egg Shakshuka ($15).
  - *Mains, Pastas & Burgers ($18–$27)*: Pan Seared Salmon ($25), Braised Beef Cheek ($27), Grilled Chicken Burger ($23), Beef Cheek Burger ($24).
  - *Kids Menu ($12–$13)*: Fish 'N' Chips, Mac 'N' Cheese, Chicken Nuggets (all served with fries/Oreos/juice and a free toy).
  - *Beverages*: Artisanal coffees ($4–$7), Italian sodas ($8), fresh juices & smoothies ($8–$12).
- **Pricing**:
  - Mid-range (~S$20 to S$40 per person).
- **Unique Selling Points (USPs)**:
  - Biophilic dining concept situated right inside the lush greenery of HortPark along the Southern Ridges trail.
  - Uniquely welcoming to four-legged companions with dedicated pet-friendly outdoor dining areas.
  - Exceptional venue for families and nature walks, connecting directly to the Henderson Waves and Kent Ridge Park trail network.
- **Travel Time from Tampines MRT**:
  - **~1 hour 16 minutes**: Downtown Line from Tampines MRT to Chinatown Station, transfer to Bus 166 or 97 towards Alexandra Road (opp Queensway Shopping Centre), followed by a 7-minute park walk into HortPark.

---

### Comparative Market Research Takeaways

1. **Pricing Spectrum**:
   - *Budget / Late-Night Treats (Under $20)*: **Burnt Cones** (gelato from $6, pints $18–$25) and **Citrus By The Pool** (weekday lunches from $9.90).
   - *Casual Cafe / Bakery ($15 – $30)*: **Tiong Bahru Bakery**, **Chye Seng Huat Hardware**, and **Canopy HortPark** (set lunches at $20.90++).
   - *Specialty Brunch & Bistro ($25 – $50)*: **My Awesome Cafe**, **Common Man Coffee Roasters**, and **Wildseed Café**.
   - *Premium Lifestyle Destination ($45 – $70+)*: **PS.Cafe at Harding Road** and **The Coastal Settlement**.

2. **Operating Hours as a Strategic Advantage**:
   - While most artisanal cafes close by 5:00 PM or 9:00 PM, **Citrus By The Pool** operates until 5:00 AM daily, and **Burnt Cones** operates until midnight (12:00 AM). Both have capitalized on late-night supper crowds to amass high review volumes.

3. **Heritage and Biophilic Environments**:
   - Singapore’s highest-rated cafes lean heavily into spatial storytelling: historical colonial/shophouse buildings (**My Awesome Cafe**, **Chye Seng Huat Hardware**, **The Coastal Settlement**, **Wildseed at Alkaff Mansion**) and green parkland glasshouses (**PS.Cafe Dempsey**, **Canopy HortPark**).

4. **Accessibility from Tampines MRT**:
   - **Fastest by public transit**: **Chye Seng Huat Hardware** (~33 min via Downtown Line) and **My Awesome Cafe** (~41 min via Downtown Line).
   - **Convenient Direct Bus**: **The Coastal Settlement** (~45 min via direct Bus 29 from Tampines Interchange).
   - **Destination Escapes (>1 hour)**: Park and hill cafes such as **Wildseed Alkaff Mansion** (1 hr 11 min), **Canopy HortPark** (1 hr 16 min), and **Burnt Cones Sunset Way** (1 hr 17 min) require feeder buses or scenic walks.

Welcome to My Awesome Cafe.

OUR STORY
On Valentine’s Day 2014, at the ground floor of the old Chung Hwa Free Clinic, we opened the doors of My Awesome Café, a place borne out of love, literally and figuratively. It is where we celebrate everything we hold dear, great food, great company, great stories. 
TRANSFORMATION
Our Family


 “I wanted to offer employees the opportunity to just be themselves – be happy and serve with their hearts."

Franck Hardy, Owner and our resident Mr. Awesome

 

The road to Awesome did not only start with the renovation of a historical shophouse. It started way before, with the decision to take a leap of faith. For Franck, a consummate F&B expert, it was a challenge to be on his own. But a challenge he doesn't face alone. He inspires everyone in our team to serve awesomeness, as he does, all the time.

My Awesome Café is our business, as much as it is our playground, our school, our home. In our own little way, we hope to share with you the familial spirit that puts a  smile on our faces and keeps us going everyday.
 
Our Renewal

From thrifted furniture and vintage dinnerware, to found objects and unfinished concrete walls, our café is filled with things that tell many a great story. With new meaning and purpose, these represent what we always want My Awesome Café to be – a place where we bring out the Awesomeness in each other.

The Coastal Settlement

​

A Timeless Escape in Changi

The Coastal Settlement is a proudly homegrown Singapore restaurant, café and bar nestled in the heart of Changi, a destination where generations of families, friends, and visitors come together to slow down, reconnect, and experience a slice of old Singapore. Surrounded by lush greenery and filled with vintage memorabilia, antique furnishings, and nostalgic treasures, every visit is an invitation to reminisce, create new memories, and enjoy the charm of a bygone era.

 

Our thoughtfully curated menu brings together beloved local comfort food and contemporary Western favourites, served with warm hospitality in a setting that celebrates Singapore's rich history and culture. More than just a meal, we offer a timeless Singaporean dining experience where stories are shared, traditions are passed on, and memories are made around the table.

Cosied at the ground level of The Alkaff Mansion, Wildseed Café is a pet-friendly floral café and patisserie that boasts a picturesque conservatory.

Market Research Report: Top 10 Most Popular Cafes in Singapore (by Google Reviews & Ratings)

To conduct this market analysis, the top 10 most popular cafes in Singapore by Google reviews and ratings were identified across all five national regions (North, South, East, West, and Central). For each cafe, the live official website and menu page has been opened and left active in its own dedicated browser tab.

---

### Regional Coverage & Summary Table

1. **Citrus By The Pool** | **North (Woodlands)** | 4.9★ (26,902 reviews) | Tab ID: 787784524 | ~1 hr 6 min from Tampines MRT
2. **My Awesome Cafe** | **Central (Telok Ayer)** | 4.7★ (7,953 reviews) | Tab ID: 787784525 | ~41 min from Tampines MRT
3. **PS.Cafe at Harding Road** | **Central (Dempsey Hill)** | 4.4★ (6,508 reviews) | Tab ID: 787784526 | ~1 hr from Tampines MRT
4. **Tiong Bahru Bakery** | **Central (Tiong Bahru)** | 4.3★ (3,378 reviews) | Tab ID: 787784527 | ~47 min from Tampines MRT
5. **Wildseed Café at The Alkaff Mansion** | **South (Telok Blangah)** | 4.5★ (3,185 reviews) | Tab ID: 787784528 | ~1 hr 11 min from Tampines MRT
6. **Common Man Coffee Roasters** | **Central (River Valley)** | 4.4★ (3,077 reviews) | Tab ID: 787784529 | ~46 min from Tampines MRT
7. **Chye Seng Huat Hardware** | **Central (Lavender / Jalan Besar)** | 4.3★ (2,911 reviews) | Tab ID: 787784530 | ~33 min from Tampines MRT
8. **Burnt Cones Gelato** | **West (Sunset Way / Clementi)** | 4.7★ (2,802 reviews) | Tab ID: 787784531 | ~1 hr 17 min from Tampines MRT
9. **The Coastal Settlement** | **East (Changi)** | 4.2★ (2,608 reviews) | Tab ID: 787784533 | ~45 min from Tampines MRT
10. **Canopy HortPark** | **South (Alexandra / Southern Ridges)** | 4.1★ (2,056 reviews) | Tab ID: 787784532 | ~1 hr 16 min from Tampines MRT

*(Note: Privé @ Keppel Bay, which previously had 2,640 reviews, was verified on Google Maps and found to be permanently closed with an expired domain; it was substituted with Canopy HortPark, a premier live dining destination in the South region).*

---

### Detailed Cafe Breakdown

#### 1. Citrus By The Pool (North Region)
- **Open Tab**: Tab ID `787784524`
  - **Tab Title**: *Citrus By The Pool - Order online for delivery & pickup!*
  - **Tab URL**: `https://ordercitrusbythepool.oddle.me/en_SG` (Official website: `https://www.citrusbythepool.com/`)
- **Location**: 3 Woodlands Street 13, Woodlands Swimming Complex, Singapore 738600
- **Google Reputation**: 4.9★ rating based on 26,902 reviews (highest review volume of any cafe in Singapore)
- **Menu Offerings**:
  - Halal-certified Western-fusion and authentic Thai dishes.
  - *Appetisers & Salads*: House Salad with Cajun Chicken Thigh ($9.50), Caesar Salad ($6.90), Homemade Mushroom Soup ($6.90), Thai Mango Salad ($6.90), Glass Noodle Seafood Salad ($6.90).
  - *Platters & Sides*: Snack Attack Platter ($18.90), Golden Bites Platter ($14.50), Truffle Fries ($8.90), Cheese Fries ($6.90).
  - *Mains, Pastas & Burgers*: Tom Yum Seafood Pasta, Grilled Cajun Chicken, Ribeye Steaks, Fish & Chips, Beef Burgers, Thai curries, and fried rice noodles.
  - *Beverages & Desserts*: Signature thick milkshakes, Belgian waffles, lava cakes, and artisanal hot/iced coffee ($3.50–$6.50).
- **Pricing**:
  - Budget to Mid-range (~S$10 to S$25 per person).
  - Weekday Lunch Deals start from S$9.90 (Mon–Thu, 11am–4pm).
- **Unique Selling Points (USPs)**:
  - Rare late-night operating hours from 11:00 AM to 5:00 AM daily (last order at 4:00 AM), making it a major supper sanctuary in the North.
  - Halal-certified casual dining situated right at Woodlands Swimming Complex.
  - High-engagement promotions: "Milkshake Madness" (1-for-1 Milkshakes every Monday) and 20% off all desserts every night after 11:00 PM.
- **Travel Time from Tampines MRT**:
  - **~1 hour 6 minutes**: Direct ride on Bus 168 from Tampines Ave 4 (Blk 503) directly towards Woodlands Interchange / Swimming Complex, or via Downtown Line to North-South Line (Woodlands MRT) + short bus ride.

---

#### 2. My Awesome Cafe (Central Region)
- **Open Tab**: Tab ID `787784525`
  - **Tab Title**: *MyAwesomeCafe www.myawesomecafe.com*
  - **Tab URL**: `https://www.myawesomecafe.com/`
- **Location**: 202 Telok Ayer Street, Singapore 068639
- **Google Reputation**: 4.7★ rating based on 7,953 reviews
- **Menu Offerings**:
  - Wholesome European cafe food and sharing platters.
  - *Signatures*: "My Awesome Salad" (generous heap of mesclun greens, smoked salmon, avocado, duck rillettes, chicken breast, and tomatoes), Awesome Sandwiches on artisanal French breads, and Foie Gras Burgers.
  - *Platters & Evening*: Artisanal cheese and charcuterie boards, antipasti platters, duck confit, craft beers, boutique French wines, and classic espresso beverages ($5–$7).
- **Pricing**:
  - Mid-range (~S$18 to S$38 per person).
  - Salads and sandwiches range between S$15 and S$26; charcuterie sharing platters range from S$30 to S$45.
- **Unique Selling Points (USPs)**:
  - Housed on the ground floor of the historic Chung Hwa Free Clinic (established 1952), preserving original retro TCM shophouse tiles, signage, and architecture.
  - Eccentric interior filled with thrifted retro furniture, upcycled industrial lighting, and vintage dinnerware.
  - Heartfelt, community-driven hospitality led by founder Franck Hardy ("resident Mr. Awesome").
- **Travel Time from Tampines MRT**:
  - **~41 minutes**: Direct MRT ride on the Downtown Line from Tampines MRT Station (DT32) straight to Telok Ayer MRT Station (DT18), followed by a 2-minute sheltered walk.

---

#### 3. PS.Cafe at Harding Road (Central Region)
- **Open Tab**: Tab ID `787784526`
  - **Tab Title**: *PS.Cafe Harding Road — PS.Cafe*
  - **Tab URL**: `https://www.pscafe.com/pscafe-at-harding-road/`
- **Location**: 28B Harding Road, Dempsey Hill, Singapore 249549
- **Google Reputation**: 4.4★ rating based on 6,508 reviews
- **Menu Offerings**:
  - Australian-inspired luxury cafe fare, brunch classics, and gourmet comfort food.
  - *Signatures*: The iconic Truffle Shoestring Fries tossed with grated parmesan and truffle oil ($19–$21), PS. Burger ($33), Tiger Beer Battered Fish & Chips ($34), Blue Moon Crab Tart ($35), and Spaghettini Bolognese.
  - *Brunch & Bakery*: Eggs Benedict, Croque Madame, and towering signature bakery desserts such as Double Chocolate Blackout Cake ($18) and Sticky Date Pudding drenched in toffee sauce ($16).
- **Pricing**:
  - Upscale / Premium (~S$40 to S$70 per person).
- **Unique Selling Points (USPs)**:
  - Dempsey Hill's pioneer flagship cafe venue (founded in 1999 as a cozy cafe in Projectshop).
  - Breathtaking glasshouse architecture with soaring floor-to-ceiling glass windows offering panoramic views of surrounding lush jungle foliage.
  - Benchmark setter in Singapore for upscale cafe ambiance, date nights, and celebration dining.
- **Travel Time from Tampines MRT**:
  - **~1 hour**: Downtown Line from Tampines MRT to Botanic Gardens / Stevens MRT Station, then transfer to Bus 7, 77, 106, or 174 to Dempsey Road, followed by a short walk through Dempsey Hill.

---

#### 4. Tiong Bahru Bakery (Central Region)
- **Open Tab**: Tab ID `787784527`
  - **Tab Title**: *Tiong Bahru Bakery*
  - **Tab URL**: `https://tiongbahrubakery.com/`
- **Location**: 56 Eng Hoon Street, #01-70, Singapore 160056 (Original flagship outlet)
- **Google Reputation**: 4.3★ rating based on 3,378 reviews
- **Menu Offerings**:
  - Traditional French viennoiseries, artisan sourdough, gourmet sandwiches, and specialty coffee.
  - *Pastries*: Celebrated French Butter Croissants ($4.50–$4.80), caramelized Kouign Amann ($6.00–$7.50), Almond Croissants, Pain au Chocolat, Apple Turnovers, and seasonal tarts.
  - *Savoury*: Quiche Lorraine ($10–$12), Croque Monsieur, Baguette Sandwiches (Brie & Roasted Mushrooms, Smoked Salmon, Roast Beef at $11–$14).
  - *Beverages*: Signature Magic (double ristretto with flat milk), Cold Brews, Matcha Lattes, and Hot Chocolate.
- **Pricing**:
  - Budget to Mid-range (~S$10 to S$22 per person).
- **Unique Selling Points (USPs)**:
  - Founded in 2012 in collaboration with famed French master baker Gontran Cherrier; widely credited with sparking Singapore’s modern artisan bakery movement.
  - Pastries are baked fresh in small batches throughout the day using premium French flour and French Normandy butter.
  - Nestled within the iconic Art Deco conservation shophouses of Tiong Bahru estate.
- **Travel Time from Tampines MRT**:
  - **~47 minutes**: East-West Line from Tampines MRT to Outram Park MRT or Tiong Bahru MRT, or Downtown Line to Chinatown Station followed by bus 851/63 into Eng Hoon Street.

---

#### 5. Wildseed Café at The Alkaff Mansion (South Region)
- **Open Tab**: Tab ID `787784528`
  - **Tab Title**: *The Alkaff Mansion – Wildseed Café*
  - **Tab URL**: `https://www.wildseedcafe.sg/the-alkaff-mansion/`
- **Location**: 10 Telok Blangah Green, Singapore 109178
- **Google Reputation**: 4.5★ rating based on 3,185 reviews
- **Menu Offerings**:
  - Modern cafe fare infused with Spanish twists, high tea, and floral patisseries.
  - *Brunch & Mains*: Big Pan Breakfast ($28 - smoked chicken bockwurst, seared avocado, eggs, roma tomatoes, tater tots, sourdough), Benny Croissant Toast, Truffle Brie Pizza, Wagyu Beef Burger, Soft Shell Crab Burger, Truffle Carbonara.
  - *High Tea & Sweets*: Circuit de Jardin High Tea set, floral-infused chiffon cakes, tarts, and botanical lattes.
- **Pricing**:
  - Mid-to-High range (~S$25 to S$45 per person).
- **Unique Selling Points (USPs)**:
  - Situated on the ground level of the stately 1918 colonial Alkaff Mansion atop Telok Blangah Hill.
  - Picturesque European glass conservatory and outdoor garden patio surrounded by nature.
  - Exceptionally popular pet-friendly dining retreat with wide outdoor lawns for pet owners.
- **Travel Time from Tampines MRT**:
  - **~1 hour 11 minutes**: Downtown Line from Tampines MRT to Chinatown / Telok Ayer MRT, transfer to Bus 131 to Telok Blangah Green, followed by a walk up the Telok Blangah hill path.

---

#### 6. Common Man Coffee Roasters (Central Region)
- **Open Tab**: Tab ID `787784529`
  - **Tab Title**: *Common Man Coffee Roasters Menu - Brunch Cafe, Wine Bar & Dine In*
  - **Tab URL**: `https://commonmancoffeeroasters.com/pages/our-menus`
- **Location**: 22 Martin Road, #01-00, Singapore 239058
- **Google Reputation**: 4.4★ rating based on 3,077 reviews
- **Menu Offerings**:
  - Third-wave specialty coffees and elevated Australian-style brunch (transitioning to a natural wine bar at night).
  - *Day Menu*: Common Man Full Breakfast ($32–$36 with organic eggs, bacon, pork sausage, herbed tomato, hash brown, portobello mushrooms, sourdough), Turkish Common Man Breakfast (phyllo-wrapped soft egg, crispy feta, olives, hummus, pita), Croissant Croque Monsieur, Organic Eggs Benedict, and Umami Mushroom Toast.
  - *Coffee*: In-house roasted single origins, Kalita Wave pour-overs, Nitro Honey Brews, and signature espresso blends ($5.50–$9.00).
- **Pricing**:
  - Mid-to-High range (~S$28 to S$50 per person).
- **Unique Selling Points (USPs)**:
  - Established in 2013 in partnership with Melbourne’s Five Senses Coffee, CMCR spearheaded Asia's specialty coffee wave.
  - Houses the renowned CMCR Barista Academy and wholesale roastery.
  - Consistently lauded by international travel publications for serving the benchmark brunch in Southeast Asia.
- **Travel Time from Tampines MRT**:
  - **~46 minutes**: Direct Downtown Line from Tampines MRT to Fort Canning MRT Station (DT20), followed by an 8-minute scenic walk along the Singapore River / Robertson Quay into Martin Road.

---

#### 7. Chye Seng Huat Hardware (Central Region)
- **Open Tab**: Tab ID `787784530`
  - **Tab Title**: *Chye Seng Huat Hardware | Coffee, Cakes & Cold Brews Delivery*
  - **Tab URL**: `https://cshhcoffee.com/`
- **Location**: 150 Tyrwhitt Road, Singapore 207563
- **Google Reputation**: 4.3★ rating based on 2,911 reviews
- **Menu Offerings**:
  - Innovative specialty coffee beverages, craft brews, brunch mains, and baked treats.
  - *Signatures*: Bottled Nitro Black Matter cold brew, espresso flights (single origin vs blend), and White/Black coffees.
  - *Food*: CSHH Breakfast ($29.43), Triple Cheese Grilled Sandwich ($22.89), Chicken Toast ($22.89), CSHH Wagyu Burger, Truffle Fries, and freshly baked pastries ($6–$8).
  - *The Courtyard*: Transforms into an evening beer garden after 5:00 PM featuring craft beers on tap and bar bites.
- **Pricing**:
  - Mid-range (~S$18 to S$35 per person).
- **Unique Selling Points (USPs)**:
  - Flagship concept space by PPP Coffee (formerly Papa Palheta) retaining the vintage exterior and metal roller doors of a 1950s hardware store.
  - Standout 360-degree circular island coffee bar in the centre of the main hall, creating an interactive, transparent stage between baristas and guests.

### Comparative Market Research Takeaways

1. **Pricing Spectrum**:
   - *Budget / Late-Night Treats (Under $20)*: **Burnt Cones** (gelato from $6, pints $18–$25) and **Citrus By The Pool** (weekday lunches from $9.90).
   - *Casual Cafe / Bakery ($15 – $30)*: **Tiong Bahru Bakery**, **Chye Seng Huat Hardware**, and **Canopy HortPark** (set lunches at $20.90++).
   - *Specialty Brunch & Bistro ($25 – $50)*: **My Awesome Cafe**, **Common Man Coffee Roasters**, and **Wildseed Café**.
   - *Premium Lifestyle Destination ($45 – $70+)*: **PS.Cafe at Harding Road** and **The Coastal Settlement**.

2. **Operating Hours as a Strategic Advantage**:
   - While most artisanal cafes close by 5:00 PM or 9:00 PM, **Citrus By The Pool** operates until 5:00 AM daily, and **Burnt Cones** operates until midnight (12:00 AM). Both have capitalized on late-night supper crowds to amass high review volumes.

3. **Heritage and Biophilic Environments**:
   - Singapore’s highest-rated cafes lean heavily into spatial storytelling: historical colonial/shophouse buildings (**My Awesome Cafe**, **Chye Seng Huat Hardware**, **The Coastal Settlement**, **Wildseed at Alkaff Mansion**) and green parkland glasshouses (**PS.Cafe Dempsey**, **Canopy HortPark**).

4. **Accessibility from Tampines MRT**:
   - **Fastest by public transit**: **Chye Seng Huat Hardware** (~33 min via Downtown Line) and **My Awesome Cafe** (~41 min via Downtown Line).
   - **Convenient Direct Bus**: **The Coastal Settlement** (~45 min via direct Bus 29 from Tampines Interchange).
   - **Destination Escapes (>1 hour)**: Park and hill cafes such as **Wildseed Alkaff Mansion** (1 hr 11 min), **Canopy HortPark** (1 hr 16 min), and **Burnt Cones Sunset Way** (1 hr 17 min) require feeder buses or scenic walks.
